d:
Jharkhand ki rajniti se bari khabar samne aaee hai. BJP pradesh adhyaksh Babulal Marandi ne apni Bulletproof Car vapas kar di hai. isko lekar unhonne mukhyamantri Hemant Soren ko chitthi bhi likhi hai.babulal marandi ke is kadam ke bad jharkhand ki siyasat men charcha tej ho gaee hai. aakhir unhonne buletapruph kar vapas kyon ki? mukhyamantri hemant soren ko likhi chitthi men kya kaha?
